jobs.title: Chief of Staff to the Managing Director of AI
jobs.description:
Location: US or Canada
Type: US Applicants - Full-Time; Canadian Applicants - Independent Contractor 

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are at and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we care about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff for our Managing Director of AI—someone who combines strategic vision in AI with hands-on execution and technological know-how. You'll be both a force-multiplier and a transformation architect: designing AI-enabled processes, building automated engines that run independently, leading organizational rollouts, and ensuring crisp execution across our AI solutions practice.

 This role goes beyond traditional Chief of Staff responsibilities. You'll design processes that leverage AI, build repeatable systems that scale, and lead entire client transformations from discovery to sustained adoption. You have the potential to grow into leading organizational-level AI implementations as the practice expands.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Strategic & Executive Leadership 

 Partner with the Managing Director of AI and the executive team to translate priorities into sequenced plans, resourcing, and measurable outcomes

 Lead Human Agency's AI transformation methodology: define offerings, build repeatable frameworks, and establish best practices for AI-enabled workflows

 Design end-to-end processes that embed AI tools (LLMs, automation platforms, knowledge assistants) into client workflows and internal operations

 Translate complex AI capabilities into clear business cases, use cases, and implementation roadmaps for executive audiences

 Produce high-quality executive materials (briefings, roadmaps, decision memos) that drive alignment and decisions

 Identify where AI creates leverage across client engagements and surface strategic opportunities to leadership

 AI Process Design & Automated Engines 

 Design and build AI-powered systems that operate independently with minimal ongoing intervention—automated engines that scale beyond individual engagements

 Create repeatable processes for AI implementation: discovery frameworks, solution architectures, evaluation routines, and governance models

 Design prompts, playbooks, and knowledge bases optimized for reliability, consistency, and reusability across multiple clients

 Implement lightweight automation using no/low-code tools (Zapier, Make, Airtable) integrated with AI capabilities

 Establish monitoring and feedback loops that enable self-correcting, continuously improving systems

 Document patterns and best practices that can be deployed at scale

 Client Service Delivery & Organizational Rollouts 

 Own end-to-end delivery on multiple client engagements involving AI-enabled solutions (e.g., knowledge assistants, workflow automations, content summarization, research copilots), from discovery through launch and sustained adoption

 Lead company-wide and client-wide AI adoption initiatives—managing stakeholder alignment, training, governance, and measurement across entire organizations

 Run comprehensive discovery to surface use cases, success metrics, risks, change-management needs, and technical requirements; translate findings into scopes, timelines, and clear acceptance criteria

 Coordinate solution build-outs with internal teammates and external partners: data/connectivity needs, tool selection, integration planning, prompt engineering, and rollout choreography

 Design change-management approaches that address skill gaps, cultural resistance, workflow disruption, and organizational readiness

 Partner with client leadership to sequence rollout phases, manage dependencies, and demonstrate ROI

 Quality, Governance & Evaluation 

 Set lightweight evaluation routines: accuracy metrics, latency benchmarks, cost tracking, quality assurance processes, and continuous improvement cycles

 Establish prompt/playbook management, basic safety/guardrail checks, and UAT plans

 Build governance frameworks that enable responsible, scalable AI adoption across organizations

 Implement monitoring systems that track performance, usage, and business impact

 Stakeholder Management & Enablement 

 Lead standing client check-ins, executive presentations, demo readiness, decision logs, and release notes, presenting succinct options and recommendations

 Create comprehensive enablement materials: user guides, FAQs, training programs, and governance playbooks that empower client teams to operate AI systems independently

 Build lasting client relationships through proactive communication, anticipation of needs, and consistent delivery quality

 Present to executive audiences with clarity and confidence, addressing concerns about accuracy, security, and adoption

 Operations & Project Management 

 Design and continuously improve the operating system for AI work: intake → triage → prioritization → delivery → QA → launch → measurement

 Manage staffing assignments and subcontractor contributions across concurrent workstreams; keep tools current (Asana/Notion, Google Workspace, Slack)

 Budget & scope control: track time against SOWs, flag changes early, manage vendors, and ensure on-budget delivery with clear documentation

 Establish shared dashboards for delivery health (timeline, risk, burn, dependency status) and run tight meeting cadences

 Communications & Reporting 

 Prepare agendas, briefings, and executive-ready presentations; synthesize complex information into actionable insights

 Provide clear, timely reporting to the Managing Director of AI and stakeholders on progress, risks, and decisions

 Contribute to Human Agency's AI thought leadership through documentation of best practices, case studies, and insights

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5-7+ years in operations, client services, product/program/project management, strategic support, consulting, or transformation roles with direct ownership of client-facing delivery

 Demonstrated success leading multi-stakeholder projects and organizational change initiatives end-to-end (scope, timelines, budgets, risk, and change management)

 Deep AI fluency: hands-on experience implementing LLM-enabled solutions, prompt engineering, workflow automation, and knowledge management systems; can shape prompts/playbooks, evaluate quality, and choose appropriate tools or vendors

 Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations, when to use AI, how to design for reliability, and how to manage risks responsibly

 Proven ability to design repeatable processes and systems that scale beyond individual projects

 Experience with no/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Zapier/n8n), knowledge bases, and modern AI tooling

 High proficiency with Google Workspace, Asana/Notion, Slack, and comfort with modern web and content tools; experience preparing polished executive documents and presentations

 Exceptional ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for non-technical audiences

 Bonus: Experience leading organizational-level technology rollouts, background in management consulting, familiarity with responsible AI considerations (privacy, data handling, consent, bias mitigation), or experience in AI/ML product development

 Mindset & Traits 

 Builder and operator: You design systems that work without constant oversight, not just execute tasks

 Strategic and tactical: Comfortable setting vision while rolling up sleeves for hands-on implementation

 AI pragmatist: Excited about possibilities but grounded in what actually delivers measurable value

 Mission-driven; systems thinker with bias for action

 Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence executive stakeholders and earn trust through delivery

 Calm under pressure with excellent judgment about when to escalate vs. solve independently

 Able to hold strategic context while driving tactical execution across multiple concurrent engagements

 Intellectually curious with strong learning agility, you stay current on AI capabilities and translate findings into practical applications

 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists

 Considerations 

 Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; an advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field is a plus

 Ethics: Commitment to ethical practices and responsible AI (transparency, human oversight, privacy, bias mitigation)

 Travel: Regular (20–40%) for client activities, organizational rollouts, and events

 Location: Remote-friendly with preference for candidates in major tech hubs

 Compensation 

 This role offers a competitive base salary with performance-based bonuses and potential equity participation. Final compensation will vary based on experience, performance, and location.

 Why Join Human Agency 

 Join a team of thinkers and builders creating meaningful impact across sectors—with autonomy to lead, the resources to succeed, and room to grow. This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse backgrounds and strive to build an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcomed and empowered.

This role offers the opportunity to shape how organizations integrate AI at scale, with clear pathways to increased leadership responsibility as our practice expands.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment

jobs.title: Director, AI Transformation
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
 Type: Full-Time Employee for US Candidates; Independent Contractor for Canadian Applicants

 **A note before you read further** 

 The world is changing fast, and so is this role. We can't fully tell you what this job looks like in six months. That's true of every role at Human Agency right now. What we need from you, no matter what: accountability, curiosity, and a builder-first mindset. If that sounds exciting, keep reading. If it sounds intimidating but you're still interested, let's talk. If none of that sounds like you, that's okay. This probably isn't your spot.

 About Human Agency 

 We're scaling rapidly and have a growing pipeline of opportunities that demand exceptional talent across disciplines. Our mission is to bring on individuals, from creative producers to technical experts to entrepreneurial leaders, who can help us realize this next chapter of growth.

 We are a company of doers. Leaders roll up their sleeves, teams work flat, and everyone contributes to what ships. Titles don't insulate us from feedback or basics. We invite critique, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar. The best ideas win here, no matter where they come from, because clients trust us to deliver the strongest outcomes every time.

 Our clients' missions, products, and bottom lines are sacred. We immerse ourselves in their world, becoming stewards of their goals and partners in solving big problems. Every product, strategy, or asset we create must be both beautiful and functional; practical, usable, and designed for real-world impact.

 Humans are our most valuable resource, and we only grow by hiring people who push us forward. Across strategy, engineering, design, data, and operations, we seek out teammates who raise the bar and make us better. Always hire up, never down.

 We partner with organizations of all sizes to explore, design, and implement AI strategies that are secure, scalable, and human-centered. We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace it, and we build with that conviction in every engagement. From advisory and tooling to implementation and education, we meet clients where they are and help them integrate AI in ways that align with their mission and values. Our goal is to empower teams to work smarter, move faster, and unlock new possibilities through thoughtful, responsible innovation.

 And through it all, we lead with purpose, love, and adventure. We do meaningful work with people we create about, and we make the ride an adventure worth taking. Because at Human Agency, who we are and how we work are one and the same.

 The Opportunity 

 Most AI consultants are good at one of two things: writing the strategy or doing the work. We need someone who refuses to separate the two. This role exists because our clients don't just need a roadmap - they need someone who will build the road, navigate the detours, and still show up to the steering committee with a clear-eyed point of view on where they're headed next.

 You'll lead AI transformation engagements end-to-end, from diagnosing what's broken and what's possible to rolling up your sleeves and building the thing alongside the client's team. That might mean designing an AI-enabled workflow on Monday, pressure-testing a product decision with a C-suite on Wednesday, and shipping a working prototype by Friday. The client doesn't see the seams. You own the outcome.

 This is the right role if you've spent years inside Big Four firms, strategy boutiques, or early-stage companies and found yourself frustrated by the gap between advice and execution. You know what good looks like, you've seen what happens when no one stays accountable for making it real, and you're done handing off decks to someone else's team. You want the whole thing - the strategy, the build, the proof.

 What You'll Own 

 Client Engagement Leadership — Run AI transformation projects from discovery through delivery, serving as the primary client relationship owner and the person ultimately accountable for outcomes.

 Strategy and Execution, Both — Develop transformation roadmaps grounded in a client's actual constraints, then stay in the work long enough to see them implemented, not handed off.

 0-to-1 Product Building — Identify high-value AI use cases, prototype solutions, and shepherd them from concept to something clients can actually use, often building hands-on alongside the client's internal team.

 Executive-Level Communication — Translate complex AI concepts, technical constraints, and strategic tradeoffs into crisp, confident communication for boards, C-suites, and frontline operators alike.

 Go-to-Market and Growth Support — Contribute to business development, help scope new engagements, and actively deepen relationships with existing clients as their needs evolve.

 AI Tool Deployment — Apply AI tools aggressively across your own workflow and your clients', not as a demo, but as a working standard for how fast and how well this work can get done.

 Internal Contribution — As a senior member of a flat, growing team, you'll help shape how Human Agency delivers, what we learn, and who we become.

 Who You Are 

 Experience & Skills 

 5–8+ years of experience in management consulting, venture-backed startups, product strategy, or a combination, with direct ownership over outcomes, not just deliverables.

 Demonstrated track record of taking AI from concept to working reality in an organizational context — not just advising on AI strategy, but building or deploying something that worked.

 Fluency with the AI tooling landscape — foundation models, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and the judgment to know when to build versus buy versus recommend against.

 Proven ability to lead client relationships at the senior level, including navigating organizational politics, managing ambiguity, and keeping complex engagements on track without a safety net.

 Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a crisp executive brief, run a working session with a skeptical VP, and explain a technical architecture decision to a non-technical founder, often in the same day.

 Experience in 0-to-1 product building — you've shipped something, taken something from nothing to real, and you can speak concretely about how you did it.

 Bonus: Background in venture studios, high-growth AI or tech companies, or operator roles at the intersection of strategy and product.

 Mindset & Traits 

 You're a builder first. Decks are useful; working things are better. You default toward making something real.

 You manage yourself completely. No one will check on your progress, remind you of a deadline, or coach you through a hard week. You are the accountability structure.

 You have no patience for the gap between strategy and execution and have spent your career closing it.

 You're curious about AI in a way that shows up in your actual work — you experiment, you break things, you have opinions formed by firsthand experience, not secondhand summaries.

 You can hold the big picture and the small detail simultaneously, and you know when to zoom in and when to zoom out without being told.

 You do what the work requires. Not what's in scope, not what's comfortable, not what's in your lane.

 Logistics 

 Location: Remote-first; US and Canada eligible. 

 Travel: Occasional travel required for client engagements, company offsites, and key strategic meetings.

 Application Note: Attach proof of something you've built with AI — a product, a workflow, a tool, a result. If you don't have something to show, this is not the right role.

 Equal Opportunity Commitment 

 Human Agency is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams where everyone can do their best work.

jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Strategy & Planning
jobs.location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry 

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. 

 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. 

 Why this role is on the menu 

 Instacart is building a new, distinctive pillar of the Instacart Platform — an emerging portfolio of AI-driven retailer solutions — and the go-to-market infrastructure to scale it is being built right now. The opportunity is real, but translating it into scalable commercialization frameworks, pricing strategies, and GTM plans requires specialized expertise and a dedicated strategy and planning leader. We're hiring a Director of AI Solutions Strategy & Planning to lead that work end-to-end. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise strategy and frontier AI, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Customer Success to shape how Instacart becomes the preferred technology partner for grocery retailers.

  

 What you'll cook up in your first year 

 A comprehensive GTM strategy for Instacart's AI-driven solutions is defined and in motion — spanning consumer experiences, ecommerce analytics, and enhanced retailer workflows — with clear positioning, pricing frameworks, and retailer onboarding playbooks in place.

 Cross-functional alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal is established, with governance forums running smoothly and transparent decision-making processes embedded across GTM and product teams.

 Pilot programs and experimentation frameworks are launched and producing real impact — validating AI-powered products with real retailer feedback and iterating based on measurable performance metrics.

 Sales teams are enabled and equipped with AI-specific strategies, enablement materials, and training programs that accelerate adoption and pipeline velocity.

 Market intelligence and competitive analysis are regularly informing product and commercialization decisions, keeping Instacart's AI solutions competitive, scalable, and aligned with evolving retailer needs.

  

 The secret ingredients we're looking for 

 Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

 8+ years of experience in strategy, product commercialization, or GTM planning, with a proven track record of defining and executing strategies for emerging offerings and driving measurable market impact.

 Experience developing GTM strategies for AI-powered products, retailer solutions, or enterprise technology platforms.

 Deep understanding of AI technologies, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.

 Expertise in product positioning, pricing frameworks, and solution packaging.

 Strong analytical capabilities, including experience with modeling, forecasting, and evaluating solution performance.

 Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills with a track record of influencing stakeholders across Product, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills for simplifying complex concepts and presenting to internal and external audiences.

 Strong quantitative skills to help inform opportunity sizing, impact assessment, pricing strategy, and financial outlook in partnership with cross-functional peers.

 Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments, with a focus on iterative learning and innovation.

  

 Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

 Familiarity with conversational AI, ecommerce analytics, or retail technology applications.

 Advanced knowledge of AI product monetization models, including subscription, usage-based, and value-based models.

 MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, or a related field.

 #LI-Remote
 Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Currently, we are only hiring in the following provinces: Ontario, Alberta, British Columbia, and Nova Scotia.

 Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

 For Canadian based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below.

 CAN
 $234,000 — $247,000 CAD

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description:
You will oversee the organization's financial direction, establish reliable financial processes, and help secure the resources needed to support its mission. Your responsibilities will include:

 Take overall responsibility for the organization's financial structure, including financial planning, management, monitoring, and control.

 Build and continuously improve a robust financial framework that supports sustainable growth and long-term stability.

 Lead budget planning, liquidity management, and the allocation of funds in accordance with nonprofit requirements.

 Develop and implement strategies to attract supporting members, donors, and other financial contributors.

 Actively contribute to fundraising by approaching potential supporters, structuring funding proposals, and supporting negotiations through to completion.

 Establish and maintain strong relationships with donors, strategic partners, and institutional funding organizations.

 Ensure transparent financial processes, reliable bookkeeping, and compliance with applicable accounting and tax requirements.

 Work closely with the leadership team to assess financial priorities, guide resource allocation, and support strategic decision-making.

 Identify opportunities to strengthen funding models and establish sustainable sources of financial support.

 Requirements: 

 You are a financially skilled and dependable professional who can combine strategic thinking with practical execution. You are comfortable working independently, managing financial priorities, and contributing to the development of a mission-driven organization. The key requirements include:

 Professional experience in financial management, controlling, or a comparable business or finance function.

 Understanding of financial structures within nonprofit organizations, or a strong willingness to develop expertise in this area.

 Ability to translate financial strategies into practical plans, processes, and measurable outcomes.

 Experience in fundraising, securing financial resources, building partnerships, or business development, or demonstrable strengths in these areas.

 Strong numerical skills and a sound understanding of financial planning models and business economics.

 A structured, reliable, and self-directed approach to work.

 Ability to build relationships with external stakeholders and communicate financial matters clearly.

 Strategic judgment and the ability to balance financial sustainability with the organization's social mission.

 Benefits: 

 100% remote work: Work from anywhere, with location-independent flexibility.

 Meaningful social impact: Contribute to an initiative focused on financial education and consumer awareness.

 Strategic influence: Directly shape the organization's financial development, resilience, and long-term sustainability.

 Ownership and autonomy: Help build and refine effective financial and funding structures.

 Fundraising and partnership opportunities: Develop a valuable network of donors, institutional partners, and impact-focused stakeholders.

 Leadership experience: Take on a visible role combining strategic responsibility with hands-on financial management.

 Purpose-driven contribution: Apply your financial expertise to a mission with potential benefits for children, parents, and educators.

jobs.description:

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services. 

 Our Mission: 

 Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

 Who We Are 
 Opensity Solutions is the largest end-to-end, tech-enabled managed services organization focused on serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms.

 Launched in 2026 through the combination of K2 Services, Epiq GBTS and Forrest Solutions, Opensity brings together more than 4,500 professionals, 500+ clients and over $400 million in combined annual revenue, with operations across the United States, Canada, India and the Philippines.

 Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

 Opensity is backed by Renovus Capital Partners, a leading private equity sponsor with deep experience investing in and scaling technology-enabled services businesses.

 For more information, visit  opensitysolutions.com.

 The Opportunity 
 We are seeking a  Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis  to lead enterprise-wide planning, forecasting, management reporting and business performance analytics. Reporting to the  Chief Financial Officer, this role will be a key partner to executive leadership, business unit leaders and our private equity sponsor. The VP, FP&A will help build a scalable, data-driven FP&A function and play an important role in Opensity's continued growth, M&A activity and long-term value creation.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and long-range planning across the organization.
 Own monthly and quarterly management reporting, variance analysis and executive performance reviews.
 Develop actionable financial and operational KPIs across revenue, margin, headcount, productivity, cash flow and profitability.
 Build robust recurring revenue analytics, including bookings, backlog, retention, churn, expansion and customer-level performance.

 Support M&A diligence, integration, synergy tracking and post-acquisition performance management.
 Help maintain a strong, diligence-ready Finance organization and support future refinancing, recapitalization or exit processes.
 Lead and develop the FP&A team.

 Qualifications

 10+ years of progressive Finance experience, including significant FP&A leadership experience.
 Private equity-backed company experience required.
 Experience working through a private equity exit, sale process, recapitalization or similar transaction strongly preferred.
 Strong experience with recurring revenue businesses and associated KPIs and analytics.
 Meaningful M&A and post-acquisition integration experience required.
 Strong data analytics capabilities with demonstrated experience automating financial reporting and analysis.
 Experience in technology-enabled services, managed services, professional services, business services or SaaS strongly preferred.

 Experience with planning, ERP and BI tools such as Sage Intacct, Adaptive, Anaplan, OneStream, Power BI or similar platforms.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform
jobs.description:
About Miovision: 
 At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!
 All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

 One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

 Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

 Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

 Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

 Position Summary: 
 At Miovision, we are engineering the future of smart transportation, and right now, we are laying down the asphalt for our most ambitious infrastructure project yet. We are building a governed, API-first technology platform that will act as the ultimate express lane for how we build software, enabling new experiences for customers, partners, and AI agents. We are looking for a Senior Director, Platform to serve as the master traffic controller for this massive transformation. Reporting to the SVP of Software Engineering & Technology, you will build the foundational highways that our entire product ecosystem travels on. You will steer our engineering organization away from gridlocked, application-centric development and into a high-speed, contract-driven future. If you are a hands-on leader ready to pave the way for AI-assisted innovation and ensure our platform capabilities always get the green light, it is time to take the wheel!

 Objectives and Responsibilities: 
 Platform Strategy & Architectural Foundation 
 Own the engineering strategy and translate our Platform North Star into clear architectural priorities for both human and AI-driven use cases.

 Spearhead the transition from application-centric integration toward a governed, contract-driven, API-first platform.

 Partner with Architecture to establish a durable technical foundation that protects long-term integrity while pragmatically supporting near-term delivery.

 Drive an engineering culture where teams naturally build on the platform because it is the absolute fastest and most effective path to delivering value.

 Organizational Leadership & Scaling 
 Lead, coach, and aggressively grow the Platform Engineering organization by recruiting top-tier talent with deep expertise in APIs, distributed systems, and AI.

 Build a highly resilient team culture grounded in ownership, curiosity, technical excellence, and high-velocity delivery.

 Lead the shift toward platform-first ways of working, building alignment, adoption, and accountability across the broader Engineering department.

 Create an environment where senior engineers are highly empowered to make decisions while remaining perfectly aligned with a shared architectural direction.

 Platform as a Product (First-Party, Third-Party & Ecosystem Enablement) 
 Partner with Product Leadership to operate the Platform exactly like a customer-facing product, treating internal developers, external partners, and AI agents as your core customers.

 Establish API contracts as first-class products that natively support authentication, observability, usage metering, and scalable commercial models from day one.

 Build a governed, unified entry point for Miovision's strategic capabilities, utilizing adoption data and developer feedback to continuously improve the ecosystem.

 Identify and build reusable, standardized capabilities—partnering with Data Science to integrate models and data products—eliminating isolated alternatives across the company.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-On Builder 
 Remain deeply engaged in the technology—reviewing architecture, exploring code, and prototyping solutions alongside your engineers to blast through ambiguity.

 Build the technical foundations for AI-assisted development, personally utilizing modern agentic tools and establishing AI-native practices across your team.

 Partner with Developer Operations to build automation and tooling that makes standardized, scalable architecture the absolute easiest path for our engineers.

 Bring razor-sharp technical judgment to complex distributed systems, helping teams practically evolve existing architecture without requiring massive, disruptive rewrites.

 Operational Excellence, Reliability & Trust 
 Establish world-class reliability, observability, security, and operational readiness as the fundamental DNA of all Platform capabilities.

 Ensure human and agent identity, delegated authorization, auditability, and guardrails are natively built into the platform rather than siloed across individual teams.

 Define strict lifecycle, compatibility, and service health standards so consumers can depend on Platform services with absolute confidence.

 Ensure the Platform seamlessly scales alongside Miovision’s rapidly growing products, customer base, and engineering organization without multiplying operational complexity.

 The Ideal Profile: 
 The Engineering Veteran: You bring 15+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on platform engineering, distributed systems, and large-scale architecture.

 The Organization Builder: You have a proven track record of successfully leading, scaling, and coaching senior engineering teams in highly complex, multi-product environments.

 The API Architect: You boast deep technical expertise in API design, microservices, contract governance, and full API lifecycle management.

 The Platform Product Thinker: You treat platforms exactly like a product. Experience monetizing a platform, scaling a marketplace, or building a third-party developer ecosystem is strongly preferred.

 The AI-Native Leader: You have hands-on experience executing platform strategies that fundamentally change how engineering teams use AI to build, verify, and deliver software (including exposure to MCP and machine-readable interfaces).

 The Hands-On Builder: You are a highly credible technical leader who is just as comfortable exploring code and prototyping a solution as you are driving an executive strategy meeting.

 The Cloud Heavyweight: You have deep, practical familiarity with cloud-native architectures (AWS), Kubernetes, modern CI/CD, and languages like Java, Python, or Node.js.

 Establish and govern enterprise data architecture standards, design patterns, information models, reference architectures, and architecture review processes.

 Lead enterprise data modeling, metadata architecture, information lifecycle management, and related architectural practices.

 Evaluate emerging technologies, data platforms, and AI capabilities to strengthen the enterprise data architecture and create business value.

 Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of Data Architects, Data Modelers, and Data Engineers..

 Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Management, or a related discipline.

 Experience partnering with Enterprise, Solution, and Cloud Architects to establish end-to-end architecture strategies.

 Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise data standards, architecture patterns, and governance processes.

 Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling.

 Experience leading Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives and enterprise information management programs.

 Experience developing enterprise information models, integration standards, and reference architectures.

 Proven ability to collaborate with senior business and technology leaders to define future-state architecture roadmaps.

 Master’s degree in a related discipline.

 Experience within financial services or another highly regulated industry.

 Experience designing or supporting modern cloud-based data platforms, preferably Snowflake.

 Experience with modern data transformation and modeling practices using dbt or similar technologies.

 Experience enabling AI, advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and digital transformation initiatives.

 Experience building and leading architecture or information management teams.

About the Team
The People Strategy & Transformation (PST) is PointClickCare's HR strategy, organizational design, and portfolio management pillar. The team includes HR Business Partners, Organizational Design & Effectiveness, People Experience, and the HR Strategy & Enablement function, with a dotted-line partnership to Internal Communications. PST is responsible for ensuring HR's work across every Center of Excellence is planned, resourced, sequenced, and tracked against business outcomes — spanning a portfolio of Pillar Initiatives, Cross-Pillar Projects, and Program Roll-Ups delivered across all four HR solution groups.
 
Position Summary:
The Director, People Strategy and HR Portfolio (Project) Management s is the VP, People Strategy & Transformation's strategic thought partner in building and running PointClickCare's HR Portfolio Management Office (HR PMO) — co-designing the strategy, governance model, capacity methodology, and dashboard reporting that let HR plan, resource, and track its work against business outcomes. This is a net-new function: no HR PMO currently exists at PointClickCare, and this role will design these mechanics in partnership with the VP rather than operate a system someone else has already built.

Operating with significant design authority but without direct reports or final decision rights on cross-functional trade-offs, this role earns influence through the credibility of the mechanics it builds and runs. It operates across all four HR solution groups without formal authority over any of them, serves as the VP's thought partner on HR strategy and the HR SLT prioritization process, and convenes HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications to coordinate how HR's work reaches the business.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Design and run the HR Portfolio Management Office’s core operating mechanics
Design and maintain the capacity management methodology, including the heat map model and the oversubscription thresholds used to flag resourcing conflicts across HR COEs
Own and run the Portfolio Council governance cadence end to end — intake, capacity check, tier assignment, publish, mid-quarter check, and close-out
Build and maintain the integrated HR initiative dashboard, ensuring data currency and accuracy across every active Pillar Initiative, Cross-Pillar Project, and Program Roll-Up
Example deliverable: a quarterly Portfolio Council capacity heat map showing every HR COE’s current initiative load, used to approve or defer new initiative intake
Serve as strategic thought partner to the VP, People Strategy & Transformation
Co-design the HR SLT prioritization process and criteria used to evaluate and sequence HR initiatives each planning cycle
Co-design the OKR and scorecard measurement architecture — what gets measured, how it rolls up, and the cadence it runs on
Co-author and stress-test the HR Strategy on a Page, contributing independent analysis before it is finalized by the VP
Example deliverable: a documented HR SLT prioritization framework — criteria, weighting, and process — adopted for the FY28 planning cycle
Own capacity management and project plan oversight across the full HR initiative portfolio
Track progress against committed business outcomes, not activity completion alone, across every active HR initiative
Maintain consistent project plan structure, milestone tracking, and dependency mapping in partnership with each initiative’s named Delivery Lead
Proactively surface cross-COE capacity collisions and resourcing conflicts before they reach Portfolio Council
Example deliverable: a consolidated project plan view across all active Program Roll-Ups, flagging dependency risk before it affects a committed milestone
Convene HR initiative stakeholders and Internal Communications on a recurring cadence
Establish and run a recurring go-to-market coordination cadence bringing together initiative Delivery Leads and Internal Communications
Sequence the timing and stakeholder readiness of HR initiative rollouts to the business, avoiding duplicate or conflicting messages landing in the same window
Maintain a shared go-to-market calendar visible to HR SLT, showing what is launching, when, and to whom
Example deliverable: a quarterly HR go-to-market calendar sequencing every planned initiative rollout to the business, reviewed and approved by HR SLT before the quarter begins
Represent HR in enterprise planning and governance forums
Serve as the primary operational liaison to the Strategic Delivery Office, aligning HR’s initiative classification and intake practices to enterprise taxonomy
Represent HR’s initiative portfolio and capacity picture in the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning cadence
Flag enterprise-level dependencies or conflicts affecting HR’s ability to deliver against committed priorities
Example deliverable: HR’s consolidated initiative and capacity submission into the Corporate Strategy Group’s quarterly planning sprint, reflecting current Portfolio Council status
 
Required Skills & Qualifications:
10–15 years of experience in program/portfolio management, management consulting, or a PMO leadership capacity, including demonstrated experience designing — not only operating — portfolio governance, capacity management, or OKR measurement systems
A track record serving as a strategic thought partner to a senior leader, with evidence of shaping that leader's thinking rather than only executing direction
Demonstrated experience operating in matrixed, cross-functional environments without formal authority over the teams being coordinated
Strong data and dashboard fluency — comfortable architecting reporting tools and the metrics model behind them, not just maintaining an existing build
Executive-level communication skills — this role prepares materials for and interacts directly with VP-level stakeholders across every HR pillar
Experience convening cross-functional stakeholder groups to coordinate sequencing and alignment on complex, multi-team initiatives
 
Preferred Experience:
Experience building a PMO or governance function from scratch, in a design capacity, rather than operating within an already-mature one
HR domain experience, including familiarity with COE structures and business-outcome-linked workforce initiatives
Experience partnering with internal communications or marketing functions on coordinated, multi-stakeholder rollouts

Head of Toronto AI Center
jobs.description:
Lab Summary: 

 Samsung Research America (SRA) develops next-generation technologies in software, user experience, and services for future products. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with locations across North America, we partner with industry and academia to translate research and innovation into tangible outcomes. We lead in machine intelligence by building AI that is user-centric and physically grounded—AI that understands not just what users want, but their physical context and environment.

 Samsung is uniquely positioned to bring this vision to life through nearly 500 million connected devices we sell annually. Our mission is to holistically integrate AI into connected ecosystems—homes, offices, robotics, and beyond—creating a platform that scales quickly while providing deep contextual understanding and spatial awareness.

   The AI Center in Toronto, Canada plays a pivotal role in developing next-generation software, user experiences, and intelligent services that enrich consumers’ lives. This lab actively contributes to the international research community through publications and presentations at major conferences.

   Areas of Research: 

 Computer Vision

 Contextual/Multi-Modal Modeling

 3D Perception & Scene Understanding

 Inference and Reasoning

 Machine and Deep Learning

 Human Computer Interaction (HCI)

 Natural Language Processing

 Position Summary: 

 Samsung’s AI research team in Toronto is looking for an outstanding and highly self-motivated leader to head the lab. The candidates should have extensive expertise in deep learning, computer vision and physics-based AI.

 The AI research center is a key part of Samsung’s global R&D effort and aims to have direct impact on future Samsung products reaching hundreds of millions of users globally. The candidate will work with a team of research scientists and engineers tackling real-world problems involving Samsung’s Artificial intelligence products. The candidate can also have the opportunity to publish at top-tier conferences in deep learning, computer vision, and language understanding.

 Position Responsibilities: 

 Build, manage, develop, lead, and support the AI research team, with the outcome of high-impact research insights that influence the product roadmap

 Present research findings and insights both within and outside of the company

 Serve as a thought partner with the executive, cross-functional, and line of business leadership teams

 Be an evangelist of research practices throughout the company, influencing partner teams

 Drive innovation programs within the relevant fields of Artificial Intelligence,

 Serve as the external face for the AI Research Lab’s advanced technology capabilities

 Drive key University technology collaboration program to build long term innovation partnerships

 Lead Technology Pathfinding to understand key technology trends and impact for Samsung, to help drive growth and new business opportunities for Samsung

 PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

 10+ years of post-PhD experience leading advanced AI research.

 Deep expertise in vision and multimodal AI and agentic AI (autonomous agents, reasoning, decision-making), plus strong foundations in computer vision, image/video processing, and generative AI applications.

 Significant experience of publishing relevant peer-reviewed articles on artificial intelligence

 Strong algorithmic problem-solving skills, and the ability to program in C/C++, Python, Java, etc.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director
jobs.description:
About us 
 Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
 We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
 Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.
 What you'll do 
 Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

 Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

 Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

 Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

 Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

 Operate as an AI-native seller: Leverage AI tools across the full sales cycle- account research, personalized outreach, call summarization, pipeline forecasting, and deal execution- to automate low-value tasks and reinvest that time into high-value customer relationships, while continuously adopting and experimenting with new tools to work faster and smarter than traditional methods allow.

 What you'll bring 
 6-8 years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

 Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota and running end-to-end complex 6- and 7-figure ACV deals.

 Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities.

 Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

 Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

 Even better... 
 Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

 Our values 
 Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

 What we offer 
 We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:
 Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 Life insurance and disability benefits

 Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 Parental leave

 Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 Free alphorn lessons

 These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.
 Be you, with us 
 We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: VP Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Teladoc Health is the global virtual care leader, offering comprehensive virtual care solutions spanning virtual care including primary, mental health, expert medical, devices and licensed platform services. Teladoc Health serves the world's leading insurers, employers, and health systems and helps millions of people around the world resolve their healthcare needs with confidence. Serving over 9 million Canadians, Teladoc Health has been in Canada for more than 20 years and operates in 175 countries world-wide.

 Position Summary 

 The Vice President, Technology and Innovation (“VP”) is responsible for defining and executing Teladoc Health Canada’s technology, product, innovation and cybersecurity strategy. The VP leads the development and delivery of Teladoc Health Canada's digital products and technology ecosystem, including product management, software engineering, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data and analytics, technology operations, and innovation. The role is accountable for building a secure, reliable, scalable, and modern technology environment that enables high-quality virtual and hybrid care, an exceptional client, clinician, and patient experience, and operational excellence.

 The VP provides executive leadership for Teladoc Health Canada's digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap, ensuring technology investments and product capabilities align with Canadian market needs, regulatory requirements, enterprise priorities, and Teladoc Health's global strategy. Working closely with clinical, commercial, operations, legal, privacy, compliance, and global technology leaders, the VP plays a key role in advancing Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework and responsible use of data and AI, while delivering technology solutions that drive revenue growth, innovation, quality of care, security, and operational efficiency.

 Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

 Technology Strategy & Delivery 
 Develop and refresh Teladoc Health Canada’s digital strategy and multi-year technology roadmap aligned with organizational strategy and business objectives;

 Provide secure, scalable, resilient and sustainable digital solutions and technology infrastructure that meet Canadian business, market and regulatory requirements;

 Lead the strategy, design, development, delivery, and lifecycle management of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem, including enterprise architecture, applications, integrations, infrastructure, and digital platforms;

 Develop and execute Teladoc Health Canada’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring appropriate security controls, resilience, and cybersecurity risk management across technology platforms and information assets

 Own the budget, portfolio, and project management of digital initiatives and ongoing technology operations, ensuring disciplined prioritization, resource allocation, and value delivery; and

 Develop and manage strategic relationships with technology partners and vendors.

 Product Strategy & Delivery 
 Lead Teladoc Canada’s multi-year product roadmap to enable operational excellence, high-quality clinical care, commercial growth, and exceptional client, clinician and patient experiences;

 Translate market, regulatory, clinical, and operational requirements into innovative digital products;

 Champion user-centred design by incorporating the perspectives of clients, clinicians, patients, and internal users throughout the product lifecycle to deliver intuitive, accessible, and seamless digital experiences; and

 Integrate customer feedback, clinical insights, analytics, and user research into product planning, development and continuous improvement.

 Data, Analytics & AI Enablement 
 Lead the operational implementation of Teladoc Health Canada's enterprise data governance framework, including data architecture, stewardship, quality, metadata, lifecycle management, and data governance technologies, in partnership with the legal, privacy and compliance teams, and business stakeholders.

 Champion enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that support operational excellence, clinical quality, innovation, and informed business decision-making.

 Develop and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable data management capabilities that enable high-quality clinical insights, operational intelligence, performance measurement, forecasting, and the responsible use of AI.

 Oversee enterprise data and analytics for the Canadian business, delivering timely, accurate, and actionable insights that support strategic planning, operational performance, and continuous improvement.

 Governance, Risk & Compliance 
 Partner with legal, privacy and compliance teams to ensure technology solutions meet applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, security, and clinical quality requirements, relevant market standards and clinical-quality expectations (e.g., PHIPA, PIPEDA, provincial health and privacy regulations, virtual care standards, responsible AI practices);

 Establish and oversee technology governance, including enterprise architecture, software development lifecycle (SDLC), cybersecurity, and cloud governance frameworks and processes, while partnering with the legal, privacy and compliance teams on enterprise data and AI governance and technology vendor risk management; and

 Identify, assess, and manage technology and cybersecurity risks by implementing appropriate controls, monitoring, and mitigation strategies to support the organization’s enterprise risk management framework, business resilience, audit readiness, and compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements.

 Technology Operations & Cybersecurity 
 Ensure reliable, scalable, and secure IT operations that support business continuity, organizational growth, and compliance with applicable organizational, contractual, and regulatory requirements;

 Oversee the performance, availability, and reliability of Teladoc Health Canada’s technology ecosystem through proactive monitoring, incident management, issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent recurrence and improve system resilience;

jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.  

 At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

 Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

 Position Summary 
 We are seeking a Director, Platform Engineering & DevOps to lead the development and maturation of our enterprise Platform Engineering organization.

 This leader will be responsible for building a modern, automation-first platform primarily focused on Microsoft Azure, while supporting remaining legacy workloads in AWS and on-premises data centers during the company's migration to Azure.

 The Director will lead the Platform Engineering team and partner closely with Network Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Security, and application Engineering to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and highly automated infrastructure platforms.

 A key objective of this role is to move the organization toward a self-service Platform Engineering model, enabling application teams to deploy and manage infrastructure using standardized patterns, Infrastructure as Code, automation, and cloud governance.

 Role and Responsibilities 
 Build, lead, and develop the Platform Engineering organization, including engineering strategy, roadmap, standards, and operating model.
 Lead the design and evolution of the company's enterprise Microsoft Azure platform, including landing zones, governance, identity, networking, security, observability, and resiliency.

 Support the migration of applications and infrastructure from AWS and on-premises environments to Azure.

 Establish Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation as the standard approach for provisioning and managing infrastructure.

 Develop reusable Terraform modules, CI/CD pipelines, reference architectures, and standardized deployment patterns.

 Build self-service platform capabilities and "golden paths" that improve developer productivity and reduce manual infrastructure provisioning.

 Partner with Network Engineering on hybrid cloud connectivity, cloud networking, Private Link, DNS, routing, firewalls, and application delivery.

 Partner with SRE to establish platform availability objectives, observability standards, resiliency practices, incident improvements, and operational readiness, leveraging Datadog Application

 Partner with SRE and Application Engineering to establish consistent standards for application and platform telemetry, including metrics, logs, distributed traces, dashboards, alerting, and service-level monitoring.

 Ensure cloud and platform services are appropriately instrumented and integrated with the enterprise observability platform.

 Partner with Security to implement secure-by-default platform patterns, cloud governance, policy enforcement, and compliance controls.

 Establish cloud cost-management and FinOps practices across Azure and remaining AWS environments.

 Recruit, mentor, and develop engineering leaders and senior technical talent.

 Provide executive-level communication regarding platform strategy, technology risks, investments, reliability, and cloud transformation progress.

 Required Qualifications 
 10+ years of progressive experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, Platform Engineering, systems engineering, or related disciplines, including significant engineering leadership experience.

 Deep technical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including enterprise cloud architecture, networking, security, governance, resiliency, and platform services.

 Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based engineering workflows.

 Demonstrated experience leading complex cloud transformation initiatives, including hybrid environments, enterprise cloud migrations, or modernization of mission-critical infrastructure.

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience building or leading an enterprise Platform Engineering organization or Internal Developer Platform.

 Working knowledge of AWS and experience supporting or migrating AWS workloads.

 Experience with Azure Landing Zones, Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, and Azure Verified Modules.

 Experience with Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

 Experience with GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, GitHub Actions or comparable DevOps platforms.

 Experience with enterprise observability and APM platforms, preferably Datadog, and technologies such as OpenTelemetry.

 Experience implementing SRE practices including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, resiliency engineering, and incident management.

 Experience implementing cloud FinOps and cost optimization practices.

 Experience operating technology platforms in healthcare, SaaS, financial services, or another regulated environment.

 Success Metrics for the Role 
 Success will be measured by the Director's ability to build a scalable Platform Engineering organization and improve the speed, reliability, security, and efficiency of infrastructure delivery.
 Increased percentage of infrastructure deployed and managed through Infrastructure as Code.

 Increased adoption of standardized Azure landing zones, reusable platform services, and self-service capabilities.

 Reduced infrastructure provisioning and application deployment lead times.

 Progress migrating targeted AWS and on-premises workloads to Azure.

 Improved platform availability and achievement of defined SLOs.

 Increased adoption and effectiveness of standardized observability and APM practices across platform and application services, including improved service visibility and reduced mean time to detect and restore.

 Reduction in infrastructure-related incidents, configuration drift, and manual production changes.

 Improved developer satisfaction and adoption of Platform Engineering services.

 Improved cloud governance, security compliance, and cost efficiency.

 Successful recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing Platform Engineering team.

 As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

 Why join Teladoc Health? 

 Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission. 

 Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

 Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.  

 Contribute to an innovative culture where fresh ideas are valued as we increase access to care in new ways.   

 Enjoy an inclusive benefits program centered around you and your family, with tailored programs that address your unique needs.

 Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn.

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, religion, color, ethnicity, national origin, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, membership in an employee organization, medical condition, family history, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, parental status, or pregnancy). In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. 

 Teladoc Health respects your privacy and is committed to maintaining the confidentiality and security of your personal information. In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).  Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information.
